Class KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<K,D,D2>

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<K,D,D2>
Type Parameters:
K - key type; key is typically primary key
D - displayValue type; displayValue provides display string
D2 - <D2> type; if present, supplementary data
Direct Known Subclasses:
GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo, SsComboBox2.BaseModel, SsComboBox2.Model
public class KeyDisplayValueSwingModel<K,D,D2> extends AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel
This class manages a list of ListItem. See GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo for GlazedList specific handling. The ListItem elements are {key, displayValue, <D2>}; where key is generally a primary key, displayValue has display info, <D2> has additional data. <D2> is optional, see setD2Enabled(boolean) and the constructors. There are ways to create, modify and examine the ListItem. Individual read-only lists for keys, displayValues, <D2> are available, for example getKeys(). <D> is conventionally known as the displayValue and <D2> is optional data. ListItemFormat creates a String to display a list item using any or all of the list item elements.

Use getRemodel() for modifying and examining the itemList and list items. Depending on how it's set up, getRemodel may give multi-thread safe access. When the list is used by Glazed remodel lock uses the EventList lock. When there's no locking, using Remodel is performant.

Since:
4.0.0
